mapper.insert: insert into waitlist(schedule_id, patient_id, join_time, status) values(#{scheduleId}, #{patientId}, #{joinTime}, #{status})
mapper.select: select * from waitlist where patient_id = #{patientId} order by join_time
select * from waitlist where schedule_id = #{scheduleId} and status = 'WAITING' order by join_time limit 1
select * from waitlist where schedule_id = #{scheduleId} order by join_time

SELECT CASE WHEN total_count = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE ROUND((success_count * 100.0 / total_count), 2) END AS success_rate FROM ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT w.id) AS total_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.id IS NOT NULL THEN w.id END) AS success_count FROM waitlist w INNER JOIN schedule s ON w.schedule_id = s.id LEFT JOIN appointment a ON a.schedule_id = w.schedule_id AND a.patient_id = w.patient_id AND a.source_type = 'WAITLIST' AND a.created_at >= w.join_time AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, w.join_time, a.created_at) <= 24 WHERE s.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND s.time_slot = #{timeSlot} AND w.join_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ) AS stats

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, w.join_time, a.created_at)), 2) END AS avg_wait_time FROM waitlist w INNER JOIN schedule s ON w.schedule_id = s.id INNER JOIN appointment a ON a.schedule_id = w.schedule_id AND a.patient_id = w.patient_id AND a.source_type = 'WAITLIST' AND a.created_at >= w.join_time AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, w.join_time, a.created_at) <= 24 WHERE s.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND s.time_slot = #{timeSlot} AND w.join_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
